findings.fix: Use the specific next point if the supplied material supports it.
findings.keep_when: Keep literal discussion of future challenges or venue-required headings.

findings.suggestion: Use a heading or transition specific to the actual next point.
findings.why: A generic transition can conceal what the next section actually covers.
